assumptions.anchor: Frozen IEX trade bar close; adjacent open is a proxy, not consolidated NBBO
assumptions.entry: Adjacent open is timing sensitivity only; the executable-clock proxy uses the first full post-decision minute in the 60-second working window, also used by stop and close studies
assumptions.fills: Whole modeled lots, no quote size, depth, queue, borrow, or partial fills
assumptions.cohort: Fixed flat-book decisions, no concurrent inventory, first funded ORB and Midday, first funded Noise per symbol; pre-quota candidate drift
assumptions.entryAtr: 10% of trailing production daily ATR14 ratio expressed at the completed close, clamped to 15–40 bp
assumptions.stopAtr: 25% of the same trailing daily ATR14 dollar amount, separate from entry
assumptions.costs: Fixed total spread/slippage stress, split between two sides, plus date-effective modeled fees; historical pre-schedule stops report gross only
